source: Czechia 26/selects/Prague (433 from the culls of 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8 Jul, plus 6876, 6864 and 6668 copied back from raw/ because they were posted)

places.prague-26: 2–8 Jul 2026 (not 4 or 7 Jul), Prague, five days: 2 Jul Vinohrady and Žižkov; 3 Jul Hradčany, the Castle, Malá Strana, the evening on the river and the Old Town; 5 Jul the Old Town Hall tower, Josefov, Charles Bridge, the embankment and the castle lights, the Old Town at night; 6 Jul Karlín, Vrtba Garden, Malá Strana, Letná; 8 Jul Vyšehrad, Strahov library

notes.instagram: Both posts are 3 Jul. DbK67DCgp8F is the evening (Loreta cover, then the Old Town and Malá Strana in the last sun); DbBIUk8giGZ is the Castle (the man photographing the tower as cover, St Vitus inside, Vladislav Hall). Matched by dHash at 0–9 bits, the uncertain ones by eye. Nothing from 2, 5, 6 or 8 Jul was posted. The 64 frames of 'Prague 26 selected' are the cull files' 'prior' lists.
